Subtitle Modality and Cognitive Load: Eye-Tracking Analysis

Authors

2026-07-08

1. Packages

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(mgcv)
library(rstatix)
library(rmcorr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)
library(conflicted)

conflict_prefer("filter", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("lag",    "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("recode", "dplyr")

2. Data Processing

2.1 Aggregate Raw TSV Files

folder_path <- '/Users/nanawu/Downloads/R/Eye-trackingData-raw'
file_list   <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = '\\.tsv$', full.names = TRUE)

cols_needed <- c(
  'Participant', 'Media', 'AOI',
  'Total_duration_of_fixations',
  'Number_of_fixations',
  'Average_pupil_diameter'
)

summary_data <- data.frame()

for (file_path in file_list) {
  raw <- read.csv(file_path, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  raw_filtered <- raw %>%
    filter(
      grepl('SDH$|ST$|LC$', TOI),
      AOI %in% c("SUB", "IMA")
    )

  missing_cols <- setdiff(cols_needed, names(raw_filtered))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    warning("Missing in ", basename(file_path), ": ",
            paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }

  raw_filtered <- raw_filtered[, intersect(cols_needed, names(raw_filtered))]
  summary_data <- rbind(summary_data, raw_filtered)
}

summary_data <- summary_data %>%
  distinct(Participant, Media, AOI, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("AOI distribution after aggregation:\n")
## AOI distribution after aggregation:
print(table(summary_data$AOI))
## 
## IMA SUB 
## 294 294

2.2 Clean and Recode

exclude_ids <- c(23, 36, 44, 16)

data <- summary_data %>%
  mutate(across(
    c('Total_duration_of_fixations',
      'Number_of_fixations',
      'Average_pupil_diameter'),
    as.numeric
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    Subtitle_Type = case_when(
      str_detect(Media, "SDH") ~ "SDH",
      str_detect(Media, "LC")  ~ "AC",
      str_detect(Media, "ST")  ~ "SS",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Modality = case_when(
      str_detect(Media, "^C") ~ "Intralingual",
      str_detect(Media, "^E") ~ "Interlingual",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Clip        = str_extract(Media, "^[CE][1-3]"),
    Participant = as.factor(Participant)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Participant_num = as.integer(str_extract(as.character(Participant), "\\d+"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!Participant_num %in% exclude_ids) %>%
  select(-Participant_num) %>%
  filter(AOI == "IMA" | (!is.na(Subtitle_Type) & !is.na(Modality)))

cat("AOI distribution after cleaning:\n")
## AOI distribution after cleaning:
print(table(data$AOI))
## 
## IMA SUB 
## 270 270
cat("Participants:", n_distinct(data$Participant), "\n")
## Participants: 45

2.3 Merge Word Count

wordcount_data <- read_excel('/Users/nanawu/Downloads/R/Wordcount.xlsx')

data <- left_join(data, wordcount_data, by = 'Media')

sub_unmatched <- data %>%
  filter(AOI == "SUB", is.na(Wordcount)) %>%
  nrow()

if (sub_unmatched > 0) {
  warning(sub_unmatched, " SUB rows unmatched — check Media naming")
} else {
  cat("All SUB rows matched successfully.\n")
}
## All SUB rows matched successfully.

2.4 Compute Final Metrics

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Total_duration_of_fixations = as.numeric(Total_duration_of_fixations) / 1000
  )

denom <- data %>%
  filter(AOI %in% c("SUB", "IMA")) %>%
  group_by(Participant, Media) %>%
  summarise(
    Fix_SUB_IMA = sum(Total_duration_of_fixations, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

data_sub <- data %>%
  filter(AOI == "SUB") %>%
  left_join(denom, by = c("Participant", "Media")) %>%
  mutate(
    Prop_reading_time      = Total_duration_of_fixations / Fix_SUB_IMA,
    Mean_fixation_duration = (Total_duration_of_fixations * 1000) / Number_of_fixations,
    Modality      = factor(Modality, levels = c("Intralingual", "Interlingual")),
    Subtitle_Type = factor(Subtitle_Type, levels = c("SS", "AC", "SDH")),
    Clip          = as.factor(Clip),
    Participant   = as.factor(Participant),
    Modality      = relevel(Modality,      ref = "Intralingual"),
    Subtitle_Type = relevel(Subtitle_Type, ref = "SS")
  ) %>%
  select(-Fix_SUB_IMA)

write.csv(data_sub, 'data/data_sub_final.csv', row.names = FALSE)
cat("Final dataset rows:", nrow(data_sub), "\n")
## Final dataset rows: 270

2.6 Collinearity Check

cor_matrix <- cor(
  data_sub[, c("Total_duration_of_fixations",
               "Mean_fixation_duration",
               "Number_of_fixations")],
  use = "complete.obs"
)
cat("Pairwise correlations among fixation metrics:\n")
## Pairwise correlations among fixation metrics:
print(round(cor_matrix, 3))
##                             Total_duration_of_fixations Mean_fixation_duration
## Total_duration_of_fixations                       1.000                  0.669
## Mean_fixation_duration                            0.669                  1.000
## Number_of_fixations                               0.781                  0.124
##                             Number_of_fixations
## Total_duration_of_fixations               0.781
## Mean_fixation_duration                    0.124
## Number_of_fixations                       1.000
cat("\nNote: Mean_fixation_duration x Number_of_fixations r =",
    round(cor_matrix["Mean_fixation_duration", "Number_of_fixations"], 3),
    "— negligible, confirming distinct theoretical constructs.\n")
## 
## Note: Mean_fixation_duration x Number_of_fixations r = 0.124 — negligible, confirming distinct theoretical constructs.
cat("Each metric enters a separate GAM; no within-model collinearity arises.\n")
## Each metric enters a separate GAM; no within-model collinearity arises.

3. Descriptive Statistics

eye_tracking_measures <- c(
  "Mean_fixation_duration",
  "Number_of_fixations",
  "Prop_reading_time",
  "Average_pupil_diameter"
)

measure_labels <- c(
  "Mean_fixation_duration" = "Mean Fixation Duration (ms)",
  "Number_of_fixations"    = "Number of Fixations",
  "Prop_reading_time"      = "Proportional Reading Time",
  "Average_pupil_diameter" = "Average Pupil Diameter (mm)"
)
desc_stats <- data_sub %>%
  group_by(Modality, Subtitle_Type) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(eye_tracking_measures),
      list(M = ~ round(mean(., na.rm = TRUE), 2),
           SD = ~ round(sd(.,   na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
      .names = "{.col}__{.fn}"

    .groups = "drop"

4. Assumption Checks

library(moments)
library(car)

cat("=== Shapiro-Wilk Normality Tests ===\n")
## === Shapiro-Wilk Normality Tests ===
for (m in eye_tracking_measures) {
  sw <- shapiro.test(data_sub[[m]])
  cat(sprintf("%-30s W = %.4f, p = %.4f %s\n", m, sw$statistic, sw$p.value,
              ifelse(sw$p.value < .05, "* non-normal", "")))
}
## Mean_fixation_duration         W = 0.8505, p = 0.0000 * non-normal
## Number_of_fixations            W = 0.9884, p = 0.0293 * non-normal
## Prop_reading_time              W = 0.9833, p = 0.0030 * non-normal
## Average_pupil_diameter         W = 0.9722, p = 0.0000 * non-normal
cat("\n=== Levene's Test (Subtitle Type) ===\n")
## 
## === Levene's Test (Subtitle Type) ===
for (m in eye_tracking_measures) {
  lt <- car::leveneTest(as.formula(paste(m, "~ Subtitle_Type")), data = data_sub)
  cat(sprintf("%-30s F(%d,%d) = %.3f, p = %.4f %s\n", m,
              lt$Df[1], lt$Df[2], lt$`F value`[1], lt$`Pr(>F)`[1],
              ifelse(lt$`Pr(>F)`[1] < .05, "* heteroscedastic", "")))
}
## Mean_fixation_duration         F(2,267) = 0.368, p = 0.6925 
## Number_of_fixations            F(2,267) = 3.707, p = 0.0258 * heteroscedastic
## Prop_reading_time              F(2,267) = 2.511, p = 0.0831 
## Average_pupil_diameter         F(2,267) = 0.218, p = 0.8043
cat("\n=== Skewness and Kurtosis ===\n")
## 
## === Skewness and Kurtosis ===
for (m in eye_tracking_measures) {
  x  <- data_sub[[m]][!is.na(data_sub[[m]])]
  sk <- round(skewness(x), 3)
  ku <- round(kurtosis(x), 3)
  cat(sprintf("%-30s skewness = %6.3f, kurtosis = %6.3f\n", m, sk, ku))
}
## Mean_fixation_duration         skewness =  2.057, kurtosis = 10.389
## Number_of_fixations            skewness =  0.254, kurtosis =  2.849
## Prop_reading_time              skewness =  0.363, kurtosis =  3.283
## Average_pupil_diameter         skewness =  0.157, kurtosis =  2.088
vif_model <- lm(
  Mean_fixation_duration ~ Modality + Subtitle_Type + Wordcount,
  data = data_sub
)
cat("=== Variance Inflation Factors ===\n")
## === Variance Inflation Factors ===
print(car::vif(vif_model))
##                   GVIF Df GVIF^(1/(2*Df))
## Modality      1.000005  1        1.000002
## Subtitle_Type 1.096546  2        1.023309
## Wordcount     1.096551  1        1.047163

5. GAM Models

5.1 Model Comparison (AIC)

families <- list(
  Mean_fixation_duration  = Gamma(link = "log"),
  Number_of_fixations     = nb(),
  Prop_reading_time       = betar(),
  Average_pupil_diameter  = gaussian()
)

aic_results <- list()

for (measure in eye_tracking_measures) {
  fam <- families[[measure]]
  f   <- function(rhs) as.formula(paste(measure, "~", rhs))

  m1 <- gam(f("1"), family = fam, data = data_sub, method = "REML")
  m2 <- gam(f("Modality + Subtitle_Type"),
            family = fam, data = data_sub, method = "REML")
  m3 <- gam(f("Modality * Subtitle_Type"),
            family = fam, data = data_sub, method = "REML")
  m4 <- gam(f("Modality * Subtitle_Type + s(Wordcount)"),
            family = fam, data = data_sub, method = "REML")
  m5 <- gam(f("Modality * Subtitle_Type + s(Wordcount) + s(Participant, bs='re')"),
            family = fam, data = data_sub, method = "REML")
  m6 <- gam(f("Modality * Subtitle_Type + s(Wordcount) + s(Participant, bs='re') + s(Clip, bs='re')"),
            family = fam, data = data_sub, method = "REML")

  aics           <- AIC(m1, m2, m3, m4, m5, m6)
  aics$Model     <- paste0("M", 1:6)
  aics$Delta_AIC <- round(aics$AIC - min(aics$AIC), 2)
  aics$AIC       <- round(aics$AIC, 2)
  aics$Measure   <- measure
  aic_results[[measure]] <- aics
}

aic_table <- bind_rows(aic_results) %>%
  select(Measure, Model, df, AIC, Delta_AIC)

kable(aic_table,
      caption = "Incremental AIC Model Comparison (ΔAIC < 2 = negligible improvement)")

5.2 Final Models (M6)

gam_m6 <- list()

for (measure in eye_tracking_measures) {
  fam <- families[[measure]]

  if (measure == "Average_pupil_diameter") {
    f6 <- as.formula(paste(
      measure,
      "~ Modality * Subtitle_Type + Wordcount +",
      "s(Participant, bs='re') + s(Clip, bs='re')"
    ))
  } else {
    f6 <- as.formula(paste(
      measure,
      "~ Modality * Subtitle_Type + s(Wordcount) +",
      "s(Participant, bs='re') + s(Clip, bs='re')"
    ))
  }

  gam_m6[[measure]] <- gam(f6, family = fam, data = data_sub, method = "REML")
}
for (measure in eye_tracking_measures) {
  cat("\n\n---\n\n")
  cat("###", gsub("_", " ", measure), "\n\n")
  print(summary(gam_m6[[measure]]))
}

5.3 Model Diagnostics

for (measure in eye_tracking_measures) {
  cat("\n---", measure, "---\n")
  par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
  gam.check(gam_m6[[measure]])
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
}

5.4 GAM Predicted Plots

subtitle_type_levels <- c("SS", "AC", "SDH")
type_linetypes       <- c("SS" = 1, "AC" = 2, "SDH" = 3)
type_shapes          <- c("SS" = 16, "AC" = 17, "SDH" = 15)

wc_seq <- seq(
  min(data_sub$Wordcount, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(data_sub$Wordcount, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 100
)

for (measure in eye_tracking_measures) {
  for (modality in c("Intralingual", "Interlingual")) {

    model <- gam_m6[[measure]]

    newdat <- expand.grid(
      Wordcount     = wc_seq,
      Modality      = factor(modality, levels = levels(data_sub$Modality)),
      Subtitle_Type = factor(subtitle_type_levels,
                             levels = levels(data_sub$Subtitle_Type)),
      Participant   = data_sub$Participant[1],
      Clip          = data_sub$Clip[1]
    )

    pred <- predict(model, newdata = newdat, se.fit = TRUE,
                    exclude = c("s(Participant)", "s(Clip)"),
                    type = "response")

    plot_df <- newdat %>%
      mutate(fit   = pred$fit, se = pred$se.fit,
             lower = fit - 1.96 * se, upper = fit + 1.96 * se)

    point_df <- plot_df %>%
      group_by(Subtitle_Type) %>%
      slice(seq(5, n(), by = 10))

    p <- ggplot(plot_df,
                aes(x = Wordcount, y = fit,
                    linetype = Subtitle_Type,
                    shape    = Subtitle_Type,
                    group    = Subtitle_Type)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                  fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.4, colour = NA) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, colour = "black") +
      geom_point(data = point_df, colour = "black", size = 2) +
      scale_linetype_manual(values = type_linetypes) +
      scale_shape_manual(values = type_shapes) +
      labs(
        title    = paste0(gsub("_", " ", measure), " | ", modality),
        x        = "Word Count",
        y        = paste0("Predicted ", measure_labels[measure]),
        linetype = "Subtitle Type", shape = "Subtitle Type"
      ) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
      theme(legend.position = "top")

    print(p)
  }
}

6.1 Load and Prepare Data

questionnaire_raw <- read_excel('/Users/nanawu/Downloads/R/questionnaire_data.xlsx')
exclude_ids <- c(16, 23, 36, 44)

diff_enj <- questionnaire_raw %>%
  filter(TOI %in% c("ENJ", "ENJ-1", "ENJ1", "ENJ-2", "ENJ2",
                    "SD",  "SD-1",  "SD1")) %>%
  mutate(
    Last_key_press = as.numeric(Last_key_press),
    # Reverse score SD: high score = difficult
    Last_key_press = if_else(
      str_detect(TOI, "SD"),
      8 - Last_key_press,
      Last_key_press
    ),
    Metric = case_when(
      str_detect(TOI, "ENJ") ~ "Enjoyment",
      str_detect(TOI, "SD")  ~ "Self_Reported_Difficulty",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Subtitle_Type = case_when(
      str_detect(Media, "SDH") ~ "SDH",
      str_detect(Media, "LC")  ~ "AC",
      str_detect(Media, "ST")  ~ "SS",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Modality = case_when(
      str_detect(Media, "^C") ~ "Intralingual",
      str_detect(Media, "^E") ~ "Interlingual",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Participant = as.factor(Participant)
  ) %>%
  mutate(Participant_num = as.integer(
    str_extract(as.character(Participant), "\\d+"))) %>%
  filter(!Participant_num %in% exclude_ids) %>%
  select(-Participant_num) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Metric), !is.na(Subtitle_Type), !is.na(Modality)) %>%
  group_by(Participant, Media, Metric, Subtitle_Type, Modality) %>%
  summarise(Score = mean(Last_key_press, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

pref_data <- questionnaire_raw %>%
  filter(TOI == "PREF") %>%
  mutate(
    Last_key_press = as.numeric(Last_key_press),
    Preference = case_when(
      Last_key_press == 1 ~ "SS",
      Last_key_press == 2 ~ "SDH",
      Last_key_press == 3 ~ "AC",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Modality = case_when(
      str_detect(Media, "^C") ~ "Intralingual",
      str_detect(Media, "^E") ~ "Interlingual",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Participant = as.factor(Participant)
  ) %>%
  mutate(Participant_num = as.integer(
    str_extract(as.character(Participant), "\\d+"))) %>%
  filter(!Participant_num %in% exclude_ids) %>%
  select(-Participant_num) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Preference), !is.na(Modality))

6.3 Friedman Tests — Subtitle Type Effect

cat("=== Friedman Test: Subtitle Type Effect ===\n\n")
## === Friedman Test: Subtitle Type Effect ===
for (metric in c("Self_Reported_Difficulty", "Enjoyment")) {
  for (mod in c("Intralingual", "Interlingual")) {

    d <- diff_enj %>%
      filter(Metric == metric, Modality == mod) %>%
      group_by(Participant, Subtitle_Type) %>%
      summarise(Score = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(
        Participant   = droplevels(as.factor(Participant)),
        Subtitle_Type = factor(Subtitle_Type, levels = c("SS", "AC", "SDH"))
      )

    res <- d %>% friedman_test(Score ~ Subtitle_Type | Participant)
    eff <- d %>% friedman_effsize(Score ~ Subtitle_Type | Participant)

    cat(sprintf("[%s | %s] chi2(%d) = %.3f, p = %.4f, W = %.3f (%s)\n",
                metric, mod,
                res$df, res$statistic, res$p,
                eff$effsize, eff$magnitude))

    if (res$p < .05) {
      cat("  Post-hoc Wilcoxon signed-rank (Bonferroni):\n")
      ph <- d %>%
        wilcox_test(
          Score           ~ Subtitle_Type,
          paired          = TRUE,
          p.adjust.method = "bonferroni"
        )
      ph %>%
        select(group1, group2, statistic, p, p.adj, p.adj.signif) %>%
        print()
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
}

for (metric in c("Self_Reported_Difficulty", "Enjoyment")) {

6.5 Preference Analysis

cat("=== Cochran's Q Test: Subtitle Preference ===\n\n")
## === Cochran's Q Test: Subtitle Preference ===
for (mod in c("Intralingual", "Interlingual")) {

  d <- pref_data %>%
    filter(Modality == mod) %>%
    mutate(Participant = droplevels(as.factor(Participant)))

  freq <- d %>% count(Preference) %>% arrange(Preference)
  cat(sprintf("[%s] Counts: %s\n", mod,
              paste(paste0(freq$Preference, "=", freq$n), collapse = ", ")))

  d_long_bin <- d %>%
    mutate(
      SS_chosen  = as.integer(Preference == "SS"),
      AC_chosen  = as.integer(Preference == "AC"),
      SDH_chosen = as.integer(Preference == "SDH")
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols      = c(SS_chosen, AC_chosen, SDH_chosen),
      names_to  = "Type",
      values_to = "Chosen"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Type = factor(Type))

  cq <- cochran_qtest(d_long_bin, Chosen ~ Type | Participant)
  cat(sprintf("Cochran's Q(%d) = %.3f, p = %.4f\n\n",
              cq$df, cq$statistic, cq$p))
}

## === Bowker's Test: Preference Shift Across Modalities ===
pref_wide <- pref_data %>%

cont_table <- table(
  Intralingual = pref_wide$Intralingual,
  Interlingual = pref_wide$Interlingual

cat("Contingency table:\n")
## Contingency table:
print(cont_table)
##             Interlingual
## Intralingual AC SDH SS
##          AC   3   2  0
##          SDH  0  19  6
##          SS   0   3 12
bowker <- function(table) {
  k <- nrow(table); chi <- 0; df <- 0
  for (i in 1:(k-1)) {
    for (j in (i+1):k) {
      n_ij <- table[i, j]; n_ji <- table[j, i]
      if ((n_ij + n_ji) > 0) {
        chi <- chi + (n_ij - n_ji)^2 / (n_ij + n_ji)
        df  <- df + 1
      }
    }
  }
  list(statistic = chi, df = df,
       p = pchisq(chi, df, lower.tail = FALSE))
}

bw <- bowker(cont_table)
cat(sprintf("\nBowker's test: chi2(%d) = %.3f, p = %.4f\n",
            bw$df, bw$statistic, bw$p))

7. Correlation Analysis

7.1 Repeated-Measures Correlations

questionnaire_clean <- questionnaire_raw %>%
  filter(TOI %in% c("ENJ", "ENJ-1", "ENJ1", "ENJ-2", "ENJ2",
                    "SD",  "SD-1",  "SD1")) %>%
  mutate(
    Last_key_press = as.numeric(Last_key_press),
    # Reverse score SD: high score = difficult
    Last_key_press = if_else(
      str_detect(TOI, "SD"),
      8 - Last_key_press,
      Last_key_press
    ),
    Metric = case_when(
      str_detect(TOI, "ENJ") ~ "Enjoyment",
      str_detect(TOI, "SD")  ~ "Self_Reported_Difficulty",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Participant = as.factor(Participant)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Participant_num = as.integer(str_extract(as.character(Participant), "\\d+"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!Participant_num %in% exclude_ids) %>%
  select(-Participant_num) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Metric)) %>%
  group_by(Participant, Media, Metric) %>%
  summarise(Score = mean(Last_key_press, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Metric, values_from = Score)

merged_data <- left_join(
  data_sub,
  questionnaire_clean,
  by = c("Participant", "Media")
)

cat("Merged data rows:", nrow(merged_data), "\n")
## Merged data rows: 270

## Missing Enjoyment: 0
cat("Missing Difficulty:", sum(is.na(merged_data$Self_Reported_Difficulty)), "\n")
## Missing Difficulty: 0
subjective_measures <- c("Self_Reported_Difficulty", "Enjoyment")

results_rmcorr <- data.frame()

for (mod in c("Intralingual", "Interlingual")) {

  d <- merged_data %>%
    filter(Modality == mod) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  for (eye_m in eye_tracking_measures) {
    for (subj_m in subjective_measures) {

      d_temp          <- d
      d_temp$eye_var  <- d[[eye_m]]
      d_temp$subj_var <- d[[subj_m]]
      d_clean         <- d_temp[!is.na(d_temp$eye_var) &
                                !is.na(d_temp$subj_var), ]

      tryCatch({
        rc <- rmcorr(
          participant = Participant,
          measure1    = eye_var,
          measure2    = subj_var,
          dataset     = d_clean
        )

        results_rmcorr <- rbind(results_rmcorr, data.frame(
          Modality    = mod,
          Eye_Metric  = eye_m,
          Subj_Metric = subj_m,
          r           = round(rc$r, 3),
          CI_lower    = round(rc$CI[1], 3),
          CI_upper    = round(rc$CI[2], 3),
          p_raw       = round(rc$p, 4),
          df          = rc$df
        ))
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
    }
  }
}

results_rmcorr <- results_rmcorr %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = round(p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH"), 4),
    sig   = case_when(
      p_adj < .001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < .01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < .05  ~ "*",
      p_adj < .10  ~ ".",
      TRUE         ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Subj_Metric, Modality, Eye_Metric)

write.csv(results_rmcorr, 'data/rmcorr_results.csv', row.names = FALSE)

      "Number_of_fixations"    = "Number of fixations",
      "Prop_reading_time"      = "Proportional reading time",
      "Mean_fixation_duration" = "Mean fixation duration",
      "Average_pupil_diameter" = "Pupil diameter"
    ),
    Subj_label = dplyr::recode(Subj_Metric,
      "Self_Reported_Difficulty" = "Difficulty",
      "Enjoyment"                = "Enjoyment"
    ),
    Eye_Metric_label = factor(Eye_Metric_label,
      levels = c("Number of fixations", "Proportional reading time",
                 "Pupil diameter", "Mean fixation duration")),
    Subj_label = factor(Subj_label, levels = c("Difficulty", "Enjoyment")),
    Modality   = factor(Modality, levels = c("Interlingual", "Intralingual"))
  )

ggplot(plot_data,
       aes(x = r, y = Eye_Metric_label,
           shape = Significant, fill = Significant)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_lower, xmax = CI_upper),
                 height = 0.25, linewidth = 0.6, colour = "black") +
  geom_point(size = 3, colour = "black") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 21, "TRUE" = 19),
                     labels = c("FALSE" = "FALSE", "TRUE" = "TRUE"),
                     name   = "BH-adjusted p < .05") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "white", "TRUE" = "black"),
                    labels = c("FALSE" = "FALSE", "TRUE" = "TRUE"),
                    name   = "BH-adjusted p < .05") +
  facet_grid(Subj_label ~ Modality, scales = "free_x", switch = "y") +
  labs(
    title    = "Repeated-Measures Correlations with Subjective Ratings",
    subtitle = "Points = r, bars = 95% CI; filled points indicate BH-adjusted p < .05",
    x        = "Repeated-measures correlation (r)",
    y        = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.placement   = "outside",
    strip.background  = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1,
                                     face = "bold", size = 11),
    strip.text.x      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    panel.spacing.x   = unit(1, "cm"),
    panel.spacing.y   = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    plot.subtitle     = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey40")
  )
